SELECT
    x.airport_id,
    x.airport_code,
    x.city_market_id,
    x.city_name,
    x.state_code,
    COUNT(*) AS occurrences
FROM `tdb-dbt-bigquery-portfolio.raw_bts.flights_2026` AS r
CROSS JOIN UNNEST([
    STRUCT(
        SAFE_CAST(r.OriginAirportID AS INT64) AS airport_id,
        CAST(r.Origin AS STRING) AS airport_code,
        SAFE_CAST(r.OriginCityMarketID AS INT64) AS city_market_id,
        CAST(r.OriginCityName AS STRING) AS city_name,
        CAST(r.OriginState AS STRING) AS state_code
    ),
    STRUCT(
        SAFE_CAST(r.DestAirportID AS INT64) AS airport_id,
        CAST(r.Dest AS STRING) AS airport_code,
        SAFE_CAST(r.DestCityMarketID AS INT64) AS city_market_id,
        CAST(r.DestCityName AS STRING) AS city_name,
        CAST(r.DestState AS STRING) AS state_code
    )
]) AS x
WHERE x.airport_id IN (13121, 14006, 14802)
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
ORDER BY airport_id, occurrences DESC, airport_code
